title: The Rockstar | All Inclusive Resort | Sleeps 32
description:
Welcome to The Rockstar Resort, Scottsdale’s ultimate luxury estate for up to 32 guests. Reimagined with over $1.5M in renovations, this 9-bedroom desert oasis blends resort-style fun and modern elegance. Dive into the heated pool, race down the 32-ft waterslide, unwind in the spa deck with sauna and cold plunge, or play pickleball under the stars. Live like a celebrity in your own private resort, perfect for families, celebrations, and retreats seeking the ultimate Scottsdale experience.

 The space 
All Inclusive: Zero Extra Fees.

KEY FEATURES

☀ 9 Bedrooms (Sleeps 32)
☀ Heated Resort-Style Pool & Commercial Water-Slide
☀ 2 Pickleball Courts
☀ Private 9-Hole Mini-Golf Course
☀ Half Basketball Court
☀ Beach Volleyball
☀ Hot Tub, Sauna, Cold Plunge & Yoga Deck
☀ Outdoor Theater & Sunken-Firepit
☀ Outdoor Kitchen with Grill & Wood-Fired Pizza Oven
☀ Game Room with F1 Simulators, Karaoke, Poker, Air-Hockey & More
☀ 20-Seat Private Movie Theater
☀ Chef’s Kitchen + Spacious Living Room
☀ Jungle Gym for Kids
☀ 10+ car-parking

☆☆ BEDROOMS ☆☆

Each of the nine bedrooms blends modern luxury with cozy retreat vibes, inspired by our travels and shows like White Lotus. Featuring bold pop-modern art, including works by emerging artists like Spanger, every room tells its own story through color, texture, and mood.

Bedroom 1 (Master Suite with King Bed):
Indulge in private spa-style en suite with get-ready station. This master suite also includes a spacious full en suite bathroom for ultimate privacy.

Bedroom 2 (Queen Bed):
Beautiful Blue stripe wallpaper with closet access 

Bedroom 3 (King Bed):
Circus themed room with red stripe and waves showcasing a jungle circus theme

Bedroom 4 (King Bed):
En-suite bathroom with high ceiling, closet, and blue colored ceilings

Bedroom 5 (King Bed):
Room with a desk, beautiful paneling and an artists paradise, merging outdoor feeling indoors with a view of the backyard

Bedroom 6 (Three Queen Beds):
Large ultra bedroom, access to the outdoor area, Ample space with bean bags and direct access to wellness zone

Bedroom 7 (Bunk Room with 6 Full Size Beds):
Perfectly designed for kids, features 3 sets of full-over-full bunk beds, stocked with games. Room features fun décor, slide, rock wall, and foam-pit

Bedroom 8 (King Bed):
With Ensuite bathroom and a window nook providing the evening sun and glimpse of wellness area and outdoors

Bedroom 9 (Queen Bed):
Views of the backyard, hand painted mural walls, upleveled design and attached bathroom

All rooms include high-quality linens, plush bedding, luggage racks and smart TVs for added comfort.

☆☆ BATHROOMS ☆☆

This home features six designer bathrooms, each with modern fixtures, and hotel-style finishes. The primary suite includes a soaking tub and rain shower, while other bathrooms feature walk-in showers and custom vanities.

☆☆ KITCHEN, DINING & GREAT ROOM ☆☆

The chef’s kitchen is fully equipped with two ovens, two microwaves, and high-end appliances, providing everything needed for large-group dining or private chef experiences. The dining area comfortably seats your entire group, flowing into a spacious open-concept living room — perfect for movie nights or relaxing after a day of desert adventures.

Floor-to-ceiling windows fill the home with natural light and offer sweeping views of the landscaped grounds.

☆☆ GAME & THEATER ROOMS ☆☆

The game room is a showstopper — featuring a pool table, air hockey, two F1 racing simulators, karaoke station, basketball throw, poker table, and subsoccer, all surrounding a sleek custom bar area.

For a cinematic experience, head to the private 20-seat movie theater, complete with reclining chairs and surround sound — perfect for movie marathons or game-day parties.

☆☆ OUTDOOR SPACE ☆☆

The outdoor area is an entertainer’s dream! Challenge friends to pickleball, basketball, or volleyball, then cool off in the resort-style pool with a commercial-grade water slide.

Gather for alfresco dining by the outdoor kitchen and pizza oven, or unwind around the sunken firepit while watching a movie in the outdoor theater.

Kids will love the dedicated jungle gym, and adults will appreciate the tranquil desert evenings under the Scottsdale stars.

☆☆ WELLNESS DECK ☆☆

The wellness deck offers the ultimate rejuvenation zone — featuring a hot tub, sauna, cold plunge, and yoga retreat space. 

• Troon North Golf Club 
• McDowell Sonoran Preserve 
• Spring Training Stadiums 
• Camelback Mountain 
• Tempe Town Lake & Desert Botanical Garden 

Whether you’re here to celebrate, explore, or unwind, Rockstar Resort places you at the heart of Scottsdale’s most exclusive experiences — you’ll never want to leave!

Guest Access
Keyless Entry

 Other things to note 
📋 House Rules (City-Enforced)
🔇 Quiet Hours: 11 PM–7 AM — no outdoor music after 11pm
🚫 No Unauthorized Parties or Events | 🚭 No Smoking inside
👥 Max 32 Guests Day/Night
🅿️ No Overnight Street Parking (Driveway holds 10 + cars)
📸 Front and back outdoor cameras for guest safety
🪪 Must be 25+ to Book | ID + Guest list and Vehicle list prior to check in
💼 Vendors (chefs, decorations, etc.) must be pre-approved by host with insurance + Fee

Please note: All guests are required to sign a separate Guest Agreement in addition to the booking platform’s terms.
After booking, we’ll send you a secure link to review and sign. Completion of this agreement is required to confirm your stay.

Unexpected issues can arise, so we strongly recommend travel insurance
